mapper.select: SELECT user_id AS userId, group_id AS groupId, user_name AS userName, user_random AS userRandom, user_end_time AS userEndTime FROM mac_user WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_name = #{userName} AND user_status = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT group_id AS id, group_name AS name, group_status AS status, group_type AS typeIds, group_popedom AS popedomJson FROM mac_group WHERE group_id = #{groupId}

SELECT user_id AS userId, group_id AS groupId, user_name AS userName, user_pwd AS userPwd, user_random AS userRandom, user_status AS userStatus, user_end_time AS userEndTime, user_nick_name AS nickName, user_qq AS qq, user_email AS email, user_phone AS phone, user_question AS question, user_answer AS answer, user_points AS points, user_reg_time AS regTime, user_login_time AS loginTime, user_portrait AS portrait FROM mac_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT user_id FROM mac_user WHERE user_name = #{name} ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 1
SELECT user_id FROM mac_user WHERE user_email = #{email} ORDER BY user_id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mac_user WHERE user_reg_ip = #{ip} AND user_reg_time > #{since}
SELECT user_id AS userId, user_pid AS pid, user_pid_2 AS pid2 FROM mac_user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
